headline: Bring eBUS heating data into view
intro: Connect Home Assistant to an ebusd daemon to read selected eBUS heating circuit values as sensors and send property writes.
highlights: Choose a circuit and monitored conditions; every condition must be supported by that circuit.
Configure the ebusd host and port; the default port is 8888. Sensor updates are throttled to 15 seconds, and reads use a 900-second cache TTL.
A write service sends a named property and value to ebusd.

flow.title: From ebusd to Home Assistant
stages: Set the ebusd host, port, and circuit.
Select monitored conditions supported by that circuit.
Read the conditions as sensors or send a property write.
